_comment: Repo-level ingestion allowlist. ONLY these repos may be ingested. Every addition or removal is a deliberate owner-visible decision recorded in design/ALLOWLIST_POLICY.md. Untrusted repos are NEVER ingested: the gauntlet (proof/test_gauntlet.py, 28/28 green) is necessary but not sufficient; expansion also requires an explicit allowlist entry.

entries.description: PING's own workspace repo (local checkout). First bounded ingestion target.
entries.purpose: First end-to-end proof: dry-run packet build, then bounded live POST to the PING gateway.
